flavor_text.one_line: Ionbria — domineering martial aristocracy of the synthesis; conquest, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Ionbria are a vigorous martial aristocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Albawyn and Ellinike [Conquest Aristocracy (albawyn over ellinike)]. They prize conquest, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field light_infantry, chariots, berserkers. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
